title: GiftManageState.note is a one-shot slot cleared only when the next gift action starts or the owner changes
trigger: Pin a gift (note = "Pinned gifts updated."), then leave the gifts list open and look at it for a long time or reopen the same owner's list
effect: The result line from the last action stays on screen until another action clears it (connect/gift_manage.rs:68,202 and reset_for_owner are the only clears)
fix: A `Notice` stage with its own expiry, or drain it like `events` (`take_events`)

title: SendGiftState::set_step writes any SendStep over the open stage, including an in-flight Sending(RequestId)
trigger: Today every caller checks `sending()` first (connect/gift_manage.rs:693,716); a future caller that does not drops the request id and the answer then goes to the 'box closed' notice path
effect: No bug today; `SendStep::Idle` also sits beside `SendStage::Open` as the stage-with-nothing-out
fix: Named transitions (`begin_send(request)`, `settled()`) instead of a public `set_step`

title: Three request stages for one gifts list (limits_ask, collections_fetch, flow) are opened and reset together by hand
trigger: begin_gift_manage resets collections_fetch/flow/note via reset_for_owner but leaves limits_ask; a different owner opens while the limits batch is Asking
effect: No bug today (limits are account wide); the three are kept in step only by the order of calls in begin_gift_manage
fix: One `GiftsList { owner, collections: Fetch, flow }` value replaced whole on owner change

title: GiftMarketState.bidding is an Option tuple beside AuctionFollow and AuctionFetch for the same auction bid
trigger: Open an auction (follow = Following), place a bid (bidding = Some((gift, request))), close the box before the answer
effect: Three fields carry one flow; bidding is cleared by hand on answer/error and has no owner-change reset visible in this file
fix: A single `AuctionFlow` enum per open auction with the bid request inside its stage

title: RequestId(0) is a sentinel for the demo in PageLoad, ResaleBuy and CraftRun
trigger: Demo fixtures put request 0 into Loading/Sending/Crafting; every waits_for/appends repeats `request.0 != 0`
effect: A magic id value stands for 'no real request'; a real request that ever got id 0 would never match
fix: A `Stage::Demo` variant or `Option<RequestId>` in the stage

title: ResaleBuy::begin_send takes a raw u64 and wraps it in RequestId
trigger: Any caller passes a counter or another id type and the stage then matches the wrong answer
effect: The rawid shape the stage-enum guard rejects for fields; here it is the constructor argument

title: ResaleBuy.pay_in_grams must change together with BuyStage::Changed(TonCents)
trigger: price_increased sets pay_in_grams = true by hand when the new price is Grams; choose_grams resets stage Changed -> Confirm by hand
effect: Two fields kept in step by hand; the comment calls pay_in_grams a choice that outlives a refused purchase
fix: Currency choice inside the Confirm stage variants, or derive the currency from the price

title: GiveawayDraft premium_winners/premium_months/star_option/star_winners are repaired by settle_* after the options arrive
trigger: Options load or change after the form opened; settle_premium/settle_stars run from the caller
effect: Four numbers must stay a pair of offered values; nothing in the type prevents an unoffered pair
fix: Store the chosen option (index into the offered list) instead of its parts

title: VenueSearch.request (Option<VenueAsk>) and .list (Option<ListData>) are two halves of one venue-list stage
trigger: venues_from_cache writes request = Answered and then apply_venues writes list; request_venues replaces request while list still shows the older answer
effect: Loading/Failed is derived from request while the rows come from list; the pair is changed together at five sites

title: AddressStage::First/Later(Lookup) records 'an address was shown once' as two variants around the same Lookup
trigger: with() rebuilds First or Later by hand at seven call sites to keep the 'shown once' bit
effect: The flag lives in the variant name next to the real stage (Lookup/Shown)
fix: `Lookup` plus a `ever_shown` carried by the Shown/Lookup data, or one stage with `previous: Option<String>`

title: Closing the picker leaves VenueBot::Resolving; the next open resets it to Unknown and sends a second searchPublicChat
trigger: Open the picker (lookup sent), close it before the answer, open it again
effect: Two lookups for the same bot; the first answer fails resolving(request) and is dropped (wasted request, no wrong state)
fix: Keep Resolving across picker opens (it is session wide) and only reset Failed/Missing

title: link_handler Stage carries bool flags stale / invalidated inside Known and Reading
trigger: invalidate() sets stale or invalidated; settle() copies it from Reading into Known
effect: Stage variants plus a bool each for 'must read again'

title: wake_when_read keeps one watcher; a second page asking while a read runs gets false and its wake is dropped
trigger: Two windows show the Settings default-app row; both ask wake_when_read during one read
effect: The second window is not redrawn when the read lands until something else redraws it
fix: A small list of wakers or a shared redraw poke

title: COMMANDS and LAST are process-wide statics with no account key; the only owner reset is clear() on account change
trigger: OS media key pressed while account A's player publishes, then the account on screen changes before the tick drains
effect: Cleared by clear() on switch (documented); any switch path that skips clear() would replay a key on the other account's player
fix: Key the queue by the publishing player/account

title: MEDIA_CACHE_SCOPE is a process-wide 'account on screen' that producers must read before handing off
trigger: A producer reads media_cache_base() after the account switched, or from a chat window of the other account
effect: Scratch files land in the wrong account's folder; the logout sweep of the other account then deletes them
fix: Pass the account's `AccountKey` (or base path) with the job instead of reading a global

title: extend_photos ignores any change of the gallery other than appended photos
trigger: With the profile photo viewer open, set a new main photo or delete one elsewhere
effect: The open viewer keeps the old list and total until it is closed and opened again (doc: 'left for the next open')
fix: Rebuild the list and keep the current item by id

title: MessageEffects.revision is a counter bumped by hand beside the lookups it describes
trigger: accept, set_available and settle_failure each bump revision; a missed site leaves a view stale
effect: A counter stands in for change notification
fix: Observe the lookups through the entity/notify instead of a counter

title: GiftPurchase.asked repeats the request id that Loading(request) holds
trigger: loading() sets both; the box compares asked to pick 'its' purchase while the stage compares its own id
effect: The same request id in two places, matched at two sites
fix: Match the box by the purchase key and keep the id only in the stage

title: Three prefs files (fast_buttons, file_prefs, gift_market/prefs) use RwLock<Option<T>> as a 'loaded' flag plus a separate global PERSIST bool
trigger: current() reads the file on the first None; tests flip PERSIST
effect: Option as a started flag; failed read caches the default for the run and a later write overwrites the file
fix: One `Prefs` store type with a Loaded/Unloaded stage
